summary: Comprehensive testing of AI-Powered Dish Nutrition & Health Analysis feature. All core features working correctly - nutrition API returns cached/AI-generated data, admin panel has Generate Nutrition AI button, modal displays full nutrition info with calories, macros, health benefits, Ayurvedic wisdom, allergens, and dietary tags.

minor.issue: Returns 502 timeout when generating nutrition for many items at once (takes >60s). This is expected behavior for bulk AI generation but may need async processing for large menus.

critical_code_review_comments: Nutrition API implementation is well-structured with proper caching in MongoDB 'nutrition_info' collection
AI generation uses GPT-4.1-mini via Emergent LLM integration - working correctly
NutritionPanel component in Menu.js displays all required fields with good visual design
Admin panel has 'Generate Nutrition AI' button with data-testid for testing
Modal close functionality works via both close button and backdrop click
Dietary tags from previous feature still display correctly on menu cards and modal

success_rate.backend: 92% (12/13 tests passed - 1 timeout on bulk generation)
